body:
# 🛡️ Unstable SMP Shields

Bring the iconic and historic shield designs from the famous **Unstable SMP** directly into your world and servers! 

This Fabric mod integrates smoothly with Vanilla Minecraft, adding an easy way to access the custom **UU Shields** menu packed with beautifully preset banners. Get instant access to legendary designs from the SMP, including the famous **Cinder Crest** shield and many more! No more tedious crafting or looking up banner recipes—everything is just one click away through a native vanilla-style experience.

---

### 🕹️ How to Use:
* 🛒 **Creative Mode:** You can find and open the **UU Shields** inventory menu directly from your Creative inventory—no commands needed!
* 💬 **Chat Command:** Simply type `/uushields` in the chat to instantly pop open the menu anywhere, anytime!

---

### ✨ Features:
* 🌋 **Iconic SMP Shields:** Includes legendary shield designs like **Cinder Crest** and other classic banners from the Unstable SMP.
* 🎛️ **Vanilla UI Integration:** Uses a clean, native vanilla chest-style interface that feels exactly like part of the base game.
* 🌐 **Server-Friendly:** Works perfectly on servers, allowing players to get their custom shields easily.
* 📱 **Lightweight & Optimized:** Built to run smoothly on Fabric, perfectly compatible with both PC and mobile launchers (like PojavLauncher).

---

### ⚠️ Disclaimer:
This is a **fan-made project** created to celebrate and enjoy the awesome custom shield designs seen on the Unstable SMP. It is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the official server owners or developers.

---

### ⚙️ Requirements & Compatibility:
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Required:** Fabric api
